newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: VILNIAUS VINGIS TO BOOST SHARE CAPITAL.
newsitem.headline: VILNIAUS VINGIS TO BOOST SHARE CAPITAL.

text.p: Lithuanian electronics maker Vilniaus Vingis on Monday said its shareholders have approved a capital increase of 13.82 million litas to 45.62 million litas.
"The share capital of Vilniaus Vingis will reach 45.62 million litas after the 13.82 million litas boost," the director general of the company Vaclovas Shleinota told Reuters.
The company plans to issue 2.764 million ordinary shares with a five litas face value.
Shleinota said the board is expected to decide on the new share issue price today but declined to say what it would be before the issue is registered with the securities commission.

Some 75 percent of the funds from the issue will be used to upgrade the company's production lines and the quality of the product, which is mainly electronic components for radio and TV sets. Some 25 percent will be used to boost the working capital.
He said that the current shareholders of the company will have one month to exercise a priority right to acquire shares in proportion to their current shareholding.
The company said earlier that it was considering a foreign investor buying a part of the new share issue.
"We do not exclude this possiblity," Shleinota said.
The company is listed on the group A of Vilnius bourse and the state runs 33.5 percent in the company.
